comment: Staff Commission admin — the recorded state of the engine, not a service response.
NO COMMISSION CONTRACT EXISTS: the PRD's commission engine is deferred platform
client has not fixed the rules or rates (docs/07-client-villa/open-questions.md —
'Commission rules and rates'). This file records only what is true today: the
engine is not configured, no statement period and no target are set, and nothing
THE HARD RULE — never add a rate, a percentage, a target amount or a statement
amount to this file. Every amount the screen shows stays blank
(COMMISSION_BLANK_AMOUNT) and is marked 'Not configured' until the office answers;
a zero would read like a real figure. tests/fixture-contract/commission.test.ts
walks this file and fails on any key that would publish one.
THE ENGINE'S VOCABULARY (bases, states, capabilities) does not live here — its one
home is lib/commission.ts, pinned to the agent workspace fixture
so the staff engine and the agent statement cannot describe different rules.
SALES ARE NOT STORED HERE: what actually sold is read from the durable order store
(lib/api-client/order-store.ts) — real recorded orders, shown without a rate applied.
